say:1:1322422001:1.text: Excuse me! Where did you first hear about the Great Will?
say:1:1322422001:1.source_cn: 劳驾！请问你在哪里得知伟大意志的呢？

say:2:1322422002:1.text: Where? Look around. Everyone in town is talking about it. You could plug your ears and still hear whispers of the "true god."
say:2:1322422002:1.source_cn: 在哪里得知？瞧瞧现在的雪松镇上吧，所有人都在议论，就算...

say:3:1322422003:1.text: However, now that you mention it, I can't quite recall where I first heard it.
say:3:1322422003:1.source_cn: 不过……到底是在哪里得知的来着？

say:4:1322422004:1.text: Wait a second, who are you? Why are you asking about this? What does it matter to you?! You shouldn't be prying into divine matters! The Great Will does not tolerate doubt. Questioning the divine brings misfortune!
say:4:1322422004:1.source_cn: 话说回来，你们又是谁？问这些干嘛！告诉你们又怎样？哼，...
